title: Aromatic Australian Fennel Wrap
description: A kid-friendly Australian dish featuring fennel seeds, leaf-wrap-steam, and ovo-vegetarian-friendly ingredients, with a grassy and creamy flavor profile.
instructions: Preheat a large non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
In a small bowl, mix together toasted fennel seeds, salt, and pepper.
Spread a tablespoon of ricotta cheese on each tortilla, leaving a small border around the edges.
Top the cheese with a few slices of cucumber, some grated carrot, and a sprinkle of fennel seed mixture.
Add a few halved cherry tomatoes on top of the other ingredients.
Drizzle a tablespoon of olive oil over the filling ingredients.
Sprinkle some chopped parsley over the top of each wrap.
Fold the bottom edge of the tortilla up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the wrap up tightly.
Place the wraps seam-side down on the preheated skillet or griddle and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until the tortilla is lightly browned and the filling is heated through.
Serve the wraps hot, sliced in half if desired.
